title: GAN-IDS-4-SDN
summary: A machine learning notebook project for intrusion detection in software-defined networks (SDN), using GAN-based models to address class imbalance in network traffic data. It fits SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and CopulaGANSynthesizer on training data to generate synthetic minority-class samples for the IDS pipeline.
evidence: IDS4SDN-MAIN.ipynb:451-457 fits CTGANSynthesizer(gan_train_metadata) and calls .fit(gan_train_data); also uses CopulaGANSynthesizer and SingleTableMetadata
